landing.hero_desc: The best way to stop phishing before it reaches your inbox. AI-powered protection that deploys in minutes, not months.
landing.trust_subtitle: Trusted by growing businesses across France
landing.features_title: Everything you need to protect your inbox
landing.features_desc: A complete email security platform that combines sovereign AI, instant remediation, and DNS-level protection.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Every incoming email is analyzed in real time by CamemBERT, a French-trained AI model. Phishing, spam, and legitimate emails are classified with surgical precision — no data leaves France.
landing.feat_remediation_desc: Identified phishing emails are automatically moved to Gmail Trash before your team can click. Zero manual intervention. Zero risk window.
landing.feat_dns_desc: Continuous monitoring and auditing of your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records. SSL certificate tracking and domain blocklist surveillance, all from one dashboard.
landing.integration_title: Protect your domain in one click
landing.integration_desc: Sicurre connects directly to your email infrastructure via Cloudflare. Paste your API token and we handle everything — email routing rules, SPF, DKIM, DMARC records — all auto-configured.
landing.integration_step_1_desc: Securely connect your domain with a scoped API token. We never store it in plain text.
landing.integration_step_2_desc: Sicurre discovers your DNS zones and sets up email routing rules to forward through our AI gateway.
landing.integration_step_3_desc: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records are created or updated. No manual DNS editing required.
landing.integration_step_4_desc: Emails now flow through Sicurre's AI pipeline. Phishing is caught and trashed before it reaches your inbox.
landing.integration_note: Works with any Cloudflare-managed domain. Google Workspace native integration. No MX record redirection.
landing.testimonial_text: Sicurre blocked 3 targeted phishing attempts in the first week. Integration took 10 minutes flat.
landing.cta_section_desc: Join hundreds of business leaders who trust Sicurre to protect their email gateway.
